name: Clawed Connections
source:
Aslan (or a different name based on your choice), a tiger who found himself homeless due to a war, got kidnapped and taken away from the life he once knew. Set in the medieval era, with a fantasy and magical touch, Aslan will choose his own skill between Fighter, Ranger, Mage and Berserker, then he found adventure and drama mixed with several possible relationships.

[Edited from [url=https://killeruwu.itch.io/clawed-connections]Itch.io[/url]]
